sources.title: Hammond 1444 Series aluminum chassis
sources.used: 1444-8 nominal outside envelope 6 x 4 x 2 inches and aluminum thickness 0.040 inch. Source product is spot welded. Study uses open corner reliefs and omits welded tabs; bend radius and hole layout are authored assumptions.

sources.title: Protocase custom sheet-metal brackets
sources.used: Public L-bracket and offset-bracket families. All study dimensions are authored; no stock part dimensions are claimed.

sources.title: Protocase U-shape enclosures
sources.used: Public U-shaped enclosure construction family. Study dimensions are authored.

sources.title: Unistrut manufacturer catalog, P1000 section, page 25
sources.used: Manufacturer-authored catalog hosted by University of Virginia. P1000 1-5/8 inch square envelope, 0.105 inch nominal thickness, 7/8 inch opening. Study is a simplified return-flange channel; lips, root radii and 120 mm coupon length are authored and do not reproduce the nut interface.

sources.title: Coer et al., Detailed experimental and numerical analysis of a cylindrical cup deep drawing
sources.used: Research study: AA5754-O, initial thickness 1 mm, blank diameter 60 mm, measured die diameter 35.30 mm, radial die-punch clearance 1.15 mm. This implies a 33.0 mm punch diameter. Our constant-thickness cup target uses 33 mm internal diameter, authored 3 mm inner bottom radius and 20 mm height. It is a geometry precursor, not a reproduction of the deformed experiment or forming simulation.

sources.title: Protolabs sheet metal bend radius guidelines
sources.used: Neutral-axis definition and dependence of K-factor on material and tooling. K=0.42 in this study is an illustrative input requiring coupon calibration, not a supplier-approved value.

sources.title: Protolabs: How and When to Add Bend Reliefs to Sheet Metal Parts
sources.used: Round relief roots help reduce tear and crack propagation. Revision 3 uses authored 0.5 mm root radii at 45-degree miter seams with a 0.5 mm normal gap. Revision 2 used 1.5 mm wide slots with 0.75 mm roots. This source does not certify the study dimensions or miter edge preparation.

sources.title: Protocase: Bend Reliefs in Sheet Metal Design
sources.used: Rectangular and rounded reliefs are both described; relief design depends on material and cutting process. The study distinguishes the relief-root radius from the sheet bend radius.
